next.reason: 1985: a format 2 (group, level 02-48) data-name 'may be used only to qualify a sum counter reference'. 2023 §2023:13.15.3 SR7 permits the data-name in GENERATE, USE BEFORE REPORTING, UPON, as a SUM operand or 'as a qualifier for a SUM counter' and says 'The data-name shall not be referenced in any other way'. GENERATE/USE/UPON name level-1 report groups (§2023:13.15.4 GR1) and a SUM operand names an entry with a SUM, SOURCE or VALUE clause (§2023:13.18.54.4 GR6), i.e. an elementary entry; so for a 1985 format 2 group entry only sum-counter qualification remains. Same requirement.
